# The original exhibition

Exhibition information (DNB publication record) is included for reference. https://d-nb.info/957409494

Exhibition title: 'while something is happening here, something else is happening there ; works 1988 - 1999' ; Spectrum - Internationaler Preis für Fotografie der Stiftung Niedersachsen ; [Sprengel-Museum Hannover, 26.9.1999 - 2.1.2000 und Staatliche Kunstsammlungen Dresden, Gemäldegalerie Neue Meister, 15.1. - 2.4.2000]. 

## The prototype

The OCR is a R&D LLM processed experiment by Chloë Farr in cooperation with Computational Publishing Service NFDI4Culture @ TIB Open Science Lab with HsH. 

This prototype made by Simon Worthington as part of the Linked Open Exhibition an experimental prototype pipeline for publishing art exhibition data as Linked Open Data (LOD). It was created with students of the Bachelor of Arts Information Management at Hochschule Hannover in the course BIM-126-02 Data Science (SoSe 2026).

# Introduction

This project is configured for:

- Quarto manuscript authoring with `.qmd` files.
- Jupyter notebooks included as project computations.
- Publishing to GitHub Pages.
- Reproducible notebook execution on MyBinder.

# Example Figure

The computational workflow is documented in the notebook set:

- [Exhibition Data](notebooks/01-exhibition.ipynb)
- [Artworks](notebooks/02-artworks.ipynb)

These notebooks are discoverable from the manuscript website and can be
downloaded by readers.
